results.title: Google's TPU 8tx and 8i Max, Announced Today, November 9, 2026 - DEV Community
results.description: The 2x lower latency on 8tx, the 2x compute and bandwidth on 8i Max, the 2.7x training and 80% inference figures — all from Google, with no independent benchmark published. Google points to InferenceX and AgentX benchmark results for its software stack, but those are its own production measurements too. These are repackaged systems, not new chips. That is a strength (fast to market) and a limit (no new silicon capability). The ceiling of what 8tx and 8i Max can do is the ceiling of the 8t and 8i silicon underneath. TPU's customer base is still small.
